projects.name: pixel-press
projects.what: A local-first, offline-only desktop video compressor built with Tauri (Rust + React). Uses on-device LLM inference via llama.cpp (SmolLM2-360M GGUF) to translate plain-language intent into FFmpeg encode plans.
projects.why: Compress videos without uploading anything to the cloud — no subscription, no watermark, full privacy.
projects.how: Rust backend with native FFmpeg and llama.cpp subprocesses, React + Tailwind + shadcn/ui frontend, Bun build pipeline, GitHub Actions CI releasing DMG and AppImage/.deb for macOS and Linux.

projects.name: mcp-harshjoshi-work
projects.what: An MCP server that exposes my project catalog and professional profile as searchable tools.
projects.why: Demonstrates MCP server design, context/retrieval engineering, and tool-use for AI agents.
projects.how: TypeScript + official MCP SDK + stdio transport; parses Markdown sources into a queryable catalog; includes a 6-case eval harness.

projects.name: local-rag
projects.what: Local RAG system for PDF resume review and cover letter generation using LangChain + Ollama.
projects.why: Enables private, local document analysis without sending sensitive resume data to cloud APIs.
projects.how: Built with Python, LangChain, Ollama (llama3), DocArrayInMemorySearch, Jupyter Notebook.

projects.name: local_webscraper
projects.what: Streamlit AI-powered web scraper using ScrapeGraphAI + local Ollama models.
projects.why: Provides a simple interface to extract structured data from any URL using natural language prompts.
projects.how: Built with Python, Streamlit, ScrapeGraphAI, Ollama.

projects.name: civit-ai-gallery
projects.what: A Pinterest-style masonry image gallery that fetches and displays AI-generated art from the CivitAI public API.
projects.why: Provides a beautiful, responsive way to browse CivitAI's vast library of AI art with validated, type-safe metadata.
projects.how: Built with Next.js, TypeScript, Zustand for state, Zod for validation, and Axios for API calls; deploys as a static export to GitHub Pages.

projects.name: ai-cache-cleaner
projects.what: Zero-dependency Bash tool for cleaning AI coding tool caches on macOS/Linux/Windows.
projects.why: AI editors accumulate gigabytes of cache; this tool cleans them all in one go with interactive selection.
projects.how: Pure Bash with ANSI TUI, supports 8+ AI tools including Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Code, OpenCode.

projects.name: ollama-optimizer.sh
projects.what: An interactive TUI that creates optimized Ollama model variants with custom context window sizes and names from any locally pulled model.
projects.why: Ollama's default context windows are often larger than needed, wasting VRAM.
projects.how: Bash script with `ollama list` for model discovery, generates temporary `Modelfile` with `PARAMETER num_ctx`, runs `ollama create`.

projects.name: mac-quantizer
projects.what: A quantization toolkit for compressing ML models on Apple Silicon Macs, specifically optimized for DrawThings integration.
projects.why: Reduces model sizes by 50-70% (5-bit/8-bit) enabling large models to run on consumer Macs with limited RAM while maintaining quality.
projects.how: Uses PyTorch (torch-ao), Metal Performance Shaders (MPS), safetensors format, and aria2c for fast downloads, with conda/venv environment management.

projects.name: ai-cache-cleaner.sh
projects.what: An interactive TUI tool that clears cache and chat history files from 8 AI dev tools with optional backup.
projects.why: AI editors and assistants accumulate gigabytes of cache and chat data that eat disk space.
projects.how: Pure Bash with ANSI TUI (arrow-key navigation, braille spinners), `du`/`df` for size accounting, background `rm -rf` cleanup jobs.

projects.name: react-native-performance-analyzer
projects.what: AI agent skill that analyzes, improves, and validates React Native app performance.
projects.why: Finds real bottlenecks, applies safe surgical fixes, and proves results in release mode.
projects.how: Reusable skill workflow with analysis templates and report formats.

projects.name: omniframe
projects.what: AI agent skill for video search and keyframe extraction from any local video.
projects.why: Helps agents find moments, scenes, objects, or visual details in screen recordings, reels, camera footage, or movies.
projects.how: Pure prompt/skill file using standard FFmpeg/ffprobe commands; no dependencies.

projects.name: git-what
projects.what: AI agent skill that generates release notes, commit summaries, and verification checklists from git history.
projects.why: Turns git history into plain, paste-ready summaries for release management and personal work reports.
projects.how: Pure prompt/skill file using standard git commands.

projects.name: project-cleaner.sh
projects.what: An interactive TUI that batch-runs custom cleanup commands across multiple client project directories with admin privileges.
projects.why: Running clean scripts across four separate project directories manually is repetitive.
projects.how: Bash script with tput-based arrow-key TUI, `sudo -v` for credential caching, parallel `eval` of per-project commands.

projects.name: dev-cleaner
projects.what: A one-click interactive cleanup utility that removes development junk files from Xcode, Flutter, Gradle, npm, Homebrew, and IDE caches to reclaim 50-100GB+ of disk space.
projects.why: Developers accumulate massive build artifacts and dependency caches across multiple ecosystems, and cleaning each one manually with different commands is time-consuming and easy to forget.
projects.how: Bash script with an interactive menu (tput-based TUI), recursive `find` for Flutter projects (pubspec.yaml detection), `rm -rf` for cache directories, and Homebrew tap support for macOS/Linux installation.

projects.name: perfmon-lite
projects.what: A blistering-fast, terminal-based mobile profiler that monitors CPU, memory, and thread telemetry for Android and iOS apps in real time.
projects.why: Gives mobile developers instant, zero-setup performance visibility without heavy IDE tools -- just connect a device and see live btop-style charts in your terminal.
projects.how: Written in Go using Bubble Tea for the TUI and Lipgloss for styling, with ADB for Android and xcrun for iOS; exports to JSON, Markdown, HTML, and PDF; ships as a single cross-platform binary.

projects.name: resume-generator
projects.what: A headless PDF generation API server that fetches resume JSON data, renders it through configurable templates, and returns polished PDF binaries.
projects.why: Provides a fast, template-driven, API-only way to programmatically generate customized resume PDFs without a headless browser.
projects.how: Built with Node.js, TypeScript, Fastify for HTTP, pdfmake for PDF rendering, in-memory content-hash caching, and deployed via Docker/CapRover.

projects.name: mac_htop.sh
projects.what: A zero-dependency, htop-style real-time macOS system monitor that displays live CPU, RAM, disk usage, and GPU/VRAM info as colored progress bars in the terminal.
projects.why: macOS lacks a built-in visual resource monitor and installing htop via Homebrew is overkill when you just need a quick glance at system health.
projects.how: Pure Bash using `top -l 1` for CPU, `sysctl hw.memsize` + `vm_stat` for RAM, `df` for disk, `tput` for cursor control.

projects.name: flutter_live_activities
projects.what: Flutter plugin for iOS 16.1+ Live Activities and Dynamic Island features.
projects.why: Enables Flutter developers to implement real-time updates and Dynamic Island interactions on iOS devices.
projects.how: Built with Flutter/Dart, integrates with Apple's ActivityKit API for live notifications.

projects.how: Built with Vite, React, TailwindCSS, deployed to links.harshjoshi.dev.

profile.summary: Engineer with 9+ years shipping full-stack products (mobile, web, backend, tooling) in fintech and creator economy, now focused on AI platform infrastructure: agent runtimes, MCP servers, eval frameworks, guardrails, and observability. Built pixel-press (open-source, local-LLM desktop video compressor), mcp-harshjoshi-work (MCP server with an eval harness), local RAG pipelines with LangChain + Ollama, reusable agent skills, and an AI harness generator for undocumented projects. Previously led a 5-person full-stack pod at Signzy and cut mobile delivery time 87.5% through automation.
